scenes.chapter: Time and Bandwidth Degrees of Freedom
scenes.title: Time and Bandwidth Degrees of Freedom

sentences.en: Would unlimited bandwidth give unlimited rate at fixed total power? Use a real lowpass band from minus W to plus W.
sentences.zh: 总功率固定时，无限带宽会带来无限速率吗？先取从−W到W的实低通信号频带。

sentences.en: Here W is measured in cycles per second, or hertz.
sentences.zh: 这里W以每秒周期数，即赫兹计量。

sentences.en: Observe the signal over a time interval of length T seconds.
sentences.zh: 在长度为T秒的时间区间内观察该信号。

sentences.en: A first intuition comes from Nyquist sampling at about twice W samples per second.
sentences.zh: 一个初步直觉来自Nyquist采样，即每秒约采两倍W个样本。

sentences.en: Over T seconds, that gives roughly two W T real samples.
sentences.zh: 持续T秒，便约有2WT个实数样本。

sentences.en: Those samples suggest about two W T effective real degrees of freedom.
sentences.zh: 这些样本提示约有2WT个有效实自由度。

sentences.en: Does this make the finite-window signal space exactly two W T dimensional?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着有限时间窗内的信号空间恰好是2WT维？

sentences.en: A signal cannot be both strictly bandlimited and strictly time limited unless it is zero.
sentences.zh: 除零信号外，信号不能同时严格带限且严格限时。

sentences.en: Cutting off a bandlimited waveform in time introduces spectral tails.
sentences.zh: 在时间上截断带限波形会引入频谱尾部。

sentences.en: Likewise, exact bandlimiting spreads a waveform beyond any finite time window.
sentences.zh: 同样，精确带限会使波形延伸到任意有限时间窗之外。

sentences.en: So two W T is not an exact dimension count for every finite window.
sentences.zh: 因此2WT并非每个有限时间窗的精确维数计数。

sentences.en: It describes effective dimension when the time-bandwidth product is sufficiently large.
sentences.zh: 当时间带宽积足够大时，它描述有效维数。

sentences.en: A more careful basis uses prolate spheroidal wave functions.
sentences.zh: 更精细的基底会使用长椭球波函数。

sentences.en: These functions concentrate most of their energy inside both chosen regions.
sentences.zh: 这些函数能将大部分能量集中在所选两个区域内。

sentences.en: Their strongly concentrated modes number approximately two W T.
sentences.zh: 其中高度集中的模态数约为2WT。

sentences.en: Modes near the boundary have intermediate concentration.
sentences.zh: 边界附近的模态具有中间程度的集中性。

sentences.en: We use the effective count without proving that advanced spectral result.
sentences.zh: 我们采用有效维数估计，不证明该高级谱结论。

sentences.en: Each real orthonormal coefficient will serve as one real channel use.
sentences.zh: 每个实正交系数将作为一次实信道使用。

sentences.en: The count is therefore approximately two W uses per second.
sentences.zh: 因此每秒使用次数约为2W。

sentences.en: Do not count positive and negative frequencies as separate complex uses here.
sentences.zh: 这里不要将正负频率分别计作复信道使用。

sentences.en: The model is real lowpass, with real coefficients.
sentences.zh: 该模型是实低通模型，系数均为实数。

sentences.en: The factor two already accounts for the real Nyquist degrees of freedom.
sentences.zh: 因子二已经计入实信号的Nyquist自由度。

sentences.en: This count will turn bits per real use into bits per second.
sentences.zh: 该计数将把每次实使用比特数转换为每秒比特数。

sentences.en: Bandwidth alone is not a signal power.
sentences.zh: 带宽本身并不是信号功率。

sentences.en: Power P is distributed across the available coefficients.
sentences.zh: 功率P分布在可用系数上。

sentences.en: Noise spectral density determines the noise variance of each coefficient.
sentences.zh: 噪声谱密度决定每个系数上的噪声方差。

sentences.en: We next compute both quantities with a consistent two-sided convention.
sentences.zh: 接下来用一致的双边约定计算这两个量。

sentences.en: The distinction between approximate dimension and exact waveform space remains in force.
sentences.zh: 有效维数近似与精确波形空间的区别始终成立。

sentences.en: Keep the real lowpass model visible in every unit conversion.
sentences.zh: 每次单位换算都要明确保留实低通模型。

sentences.en: The output will be a rate in bits per second.
sentences.zh: 结果将是以比特每秒计量的速率。

scenes.chapter: From Uses to Bits per Second
scenes.title: From Uses to Bits per Second

sentences.en: Use a real lowpass band from negative W to positive W.
sentences.zh: 使用频带为−W至W的实低通信道。

sentences.en: Its approximate real orthonormal coefficient rate is two W per second.
sentences.zh: 其正交实系数速率近似为每秒2W个。

sentences.en: Let total average signal power be P watts.
sentences.zh: 令总平均信号功率为P瓦。

sentences.en: Over T seconds, the energy budget is P T across approximately two W T coefficients.
sentences.zh: 在T秒内，能量预算PT分布在约2WT个系数上。

sentences.en: Orthonormality equates total waveform energy with the sum of squared coefficients.
sentences.zh: 正交归一性使波形总能量等于系数平方和。

sentences.en: Under uniform allocation, each real coefficient has input second moment P divided by the product two times W.
sentences.zh: 均匀分配时，每个实系数的输入二阶矩为P/(2W)。

sentences.en: This is mean energy per orthonormal coefficient, rather than total power P.
sentences.zh: 这是每个正交系数的平均能量，而不是总功率P。

sentences.en: Let the two-sided white-noise spectral density be N zero over two.
sentences.zh: 令双边白噪声谱密度为N₀/2。

sentences.en: Assume W and N zero are positive, with Gaussian white noise independent of the input.
sentences.zh: 假设W与N₀均为正，且高斯白噪声独立于输入。

sentences.en: Orthogonal projections of this noise are jointly Gaussian and uncorrelated, hence independent.
sentences.zh: 该噪声的正交投影联合高斯且不相关，因此独立。

sentences.en: Integrate that density across the band from negative W to positive W.
sentences.zh: 将该谱密度在−W至W频带上积分。

sentences.en: The total in-band noise power is N zero W.
sentences.zh: 带内总噪声功率为N₀W。

sentences.en: An orthonormal real coefficient therefore has noise variance N zero over two.
sentences.zh: 因此每个正交实系数的噪声方差为N₀/2。

sentences.en: A unit-energy basis function gives this variance through its squared-norm integral.
sentences.zh: 对单位能量基函数积分其模平方，就得到该噪声方差。

sentences.en: The coefficient signal-to-noise ratio is its input second moment divided by noise variance.
sentences.zh: 系数信噪比等于输入二阶矩除以噪声方差。

sentences.en: Substitution gives P divided by the product N zero times W.
sentences.zh: 代入后得到P/(N₀W)。

sentences.en: One real use has capacity one half log two of one plus that ratio.
sentences.zh: 一次实信道使用的容量为二分之一log₂(1加该比值)。

sentences.en: The one half is the real Gaussian capacity factor from the previous episode.
sentences.zh: 因子二分之一是上一集实高斯容量公式中的因子。

sentences.en: Multiply by about two W real uses per second. Does the real Gaussian factor one half remain?
sentences.zh: 再乘每秒约2W次实信道使用。实高斯公式中的二分之一还会留下吗？

sentences.en: The two factors of one half and two cancel.
sentences.zh: 两个因子二分之一与二相消。

sentences.en: Capacity is W times log base two of one plus the ratio P divided by the product N zero times W.
sentences.zh: 所得容量为W log₂(1+P/(N₀W))。

sentences.en: Its unit is bits per second.
sentences.zh: 其单位是比特每秒。

sentences.en: The logarithm argument is dimensionless.
sentences.zh: 对数的自变量是无量纲量。

sentences.en: The coefficient variance must not be confused with total power.
sentences.zh: 不能把系数方差误当成总功率。

sentences.en: Total noise power is an integral over the full band.
sentences.zh: 总噪声功率是对整个频带积分所得。

sentences.en: Each coefficient receives only its share of signal energy.
sentences.zh: 每个系数只获得其对应的信号能量份额。

sentences.en: Changing to a one-sided density would require changing the convention consistently.
sentences.zh: 若改用单边谱密度，必须一致地更改约定。

sentences.en: Here all calculations use two-sided density N zero over two.
sentences.zh: 这里所有计算均采用双边谱密度N₀/2。

sentences.en: At fixed W, more total power raises the coefficient ratio.
sentences.zh: 固定W时，总功率增加会提高系数信噪比。

sentences.en: At fixed P, widening the band lowers power per coefficient.
sentences.zh: 固定P时，增宽频带会降低每系数功率。

sentences.en: This conversion depends on the real lowpass interpretation.
sentences.zh: 该换算依赖实低通解释。

sentences.en: It does not add a constant to bits per use.
sentences.zh: 它不是在每次使用比特数上加一个常数。

sentences.en: The bandwidth multiplies a dimensionless logarithmic rate.
sentences.zh: 带宽乘以一个无量纲对数速率。

sentences.en: The next limit balances that weaker coefficient against more uses per second.
sentences.zh: 接下来考察这一较弱系数与更多每秒使用次数之间的平衡。

sentences.en: Fix positive total power P and positive noise density N zero. Can unlimited bandwidth give unlimited bits per second?
sentences.zh: 固定正总功率P和正噪声谱密度N₀。无限带宽能带来每秒无限比特吗？

sentences.en: Capacity is W times log base two of one plus the ratio P divided by the product N zero times W.
sentences.zh: 每秒容量为W log₂(1+P/(N₀W))。

sentences.en: As bandwidth W grows, the power in each coefficient falls.
sentences.zh: 带宽W增大时，每个系数分到的功率下降。

sentences.en: Define x as P divided by the product N zero times W.
sentences.zh: 定义x=P/(N₀W)。

sentences.en: Then x tends to zero as W tends to infinity.
sentences.zh: 当W趋于无穷时，x趋于零。

sentences.en: Capacity is P divided by N zero, times the fraction log base two of one plus x, all over x.
sentences.zh: 将容量改写为P/N₀乘以log₂(1+x)/x。

sentences.en: For small x, natural log of one plus x divided by x tends to one.
sentences.zh: 当x很小时，ln(1+x)/x趋于一。

sentences.en: Changing from natural logarithms to base two divides by natural log two.
sentences.zh: 从自然对数换为以二为底的对数，需除以ln2。

sentences.en: Therefore capacity tends to P divided by the product N zero times natural log two.
sentences.zh: 因此容量趋于P/(N₀ln2)。

sentences.en: The limiting unit remains bits per second.
sentences.zh: 极限单位仍为比特每秒。

sentences.en: For positive P and finite W, capacity is strictly below this limit.
sentences.zh: 当P为正且W有限时，容量严格低于该极限。

sentences.en: This follows because natural log of one plus x is strictly less than x for positive x.
sentences.zh: 这是因为x>0时，自然对数ln(1+x)严格小于x。

sentences.en: Thus widening the band gives diminishing extra capacity.
sentences.zh: 因此增宽频带带来的额外容量逐渐减小。

sentences.en: It never makes capacity grow without bound at fixed total power.
sentences.zh: 固定总功率时，容量不会因此无限增长。

sentences.en: Spectral efficiency is capacity divided by bandwidth.
sentences.zh: 频谱效率定义为容量除以带宽。

sentences.en: Here that ratio is log two of one plus x.
sentences.zh: 这里该比值为log₂(1+x)。

sentences.en: As bandwidth grows, spectral efficiency tends to zero.
sentences.zh: 带宽增大时，频谱效率趋于零。

sentences.en: More hertz carry progressively fewer bits per second per hertz.
sentences.zh: 每赫兹承载的每秒比特数逐渐减少。

sentences.en: Meanwhile the total rate approaches the finite power-limited value.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，总速率趋于有限的功率限制值。

sentences.en: This is not a contradiction because the bandwidth itself keeps increasing.
sentences.zh: 这并不矛盾，因为带宽本身仍持续增加。

sentences.en: The small coefficient signal-to-noise ratio is compensated by more real uses.
sentences.zh: 更多实信道使用次数补偿了较低的系数信噪比。

sentences.en: The first-order logarithm term determines the limit.
sentences.zh: 对数展开的一阶项决定该极限。

sentences.en: Higher-order terms vanish after multiplication by W.
sentences.zh: 乘以W后，高阶项趋于零。

sentences.en: The fixed quantity is total power, not power per hertz.
sentences.zh: 固定的是总功率，而不是每赫兹功率。

sentences.en: If power per hertz stayed fixed, total power would instead grow with bandwidth.
sentences.zh: 若每赫兹功率固定，总功率反而会随带宽增加。

sentences.en: That would be a different limiting experiment.
sentences.zh: 那将是另一种极限设定。

sentences.en: This produces an energy-per-bit measure.
sentences.zh: 由此得到每比特能量指标。

sentences.en: The limiting value can be stated in units of noise density.
sentences.zh: 极限值可以噪声谱密度为单位表示。

sentences.en: The logarithm base determines the factor natural log two.
sentences.zh: 对数底数决定因子ln2。

sentences.en: At P equal zero, capacity is zero at every bandwidth, including its wideband limit.
sentences.zh: 若P=0，则任意带宽下容量及其宽带极限都为零。

sentences.en: The next chapter divides power by the actual communication rate.
sentences.zh: 下一章将用总功率除以实际通信速率。

scenes.chapter: Energy per Bit and Spectral Efficiency
scenes.title: Energy per Bit and Spectral Efficiency

sentences.en: Let R be an actual reliable communication rate in bits per second.
sentences.zh: 令R为实际可靠通信速率，单位为比特每秒。

sentences.en: The noise density N zero has units of watts per hertz.
sentences.zh: 噪声谱密度N₀的单位是瓦特每赫兹。

sentences.en: The reliable rate R cannot exceed channel capacity C.
sentences.zh: 可靠速率R不能超过信道容量C。

sentences.en: Define energy per bit as total signal power P divided by R.
sentences.zh: 定义每比特能量E_b=P/R。

sentences.en: This definition applies to any positive operating rate.
sentences.zh: 该定义适用于任意正工作速率。

sentences.en: Define spectral efficiency eta as R divided by bandwidth W.
sentences.zh: 定义频谱效率η=R/W。

sentences.en: At the Shannon boundary, R equals C.
sentences.zh: 在Shannon边界上，R=C。

sentences.en: Then eta equals log two of one plus P over N zero W.
sentences.zh: 此时η=log₂(1+P/(N₀W))。

sentences.en: Rearrange: P divided by the product N zero times W equals two raised to eta, minus one.
sentences.zh: 整理得P/(N₀W)=2^η−1。

sentences.en: Divide power by rate and normalize by N zero.
sentences.zh: 用功率除以速率，再以N₀归一化。

sentences.en: At capacity, E b over N zero is two raised to eta, minus one, with the entire difference divided by eta.
sentences.zh: 在容量边界上，E_b/N₀=(2^η−1)/η。

sentences.en: For an operating rate below capacity, the required ratio is at least this frontier value.
sentences.zh: 若工作速率低于容量，所需比值至少达到该前沿值。

sentences.en: Since R cannot exceed C, the ratio P divided by the product N zero times W must be at least two raised to eta, minus one.
sentences.zh: 由于R≤C，支持速率R要求P/(N₀W)至少为2^η−1。

sentences.en: The inequality follows because the same power supports a larger capacity rate.
sentences.zh: 这是因为相同功率支持的容量速率更高。

sentences.en: Let spectral efficiency approach zero. Must the required energy per bit approach zero too?
sentences.zh: 让频谱效率趋于零。所需每比特能量也一定趋于零吗？

sentences.en: Since two to eta is one plus eta ln two plus a term smaller than eta, the ratio tends to natural log two.
sentences.zh: 因为2的η次方等于1+ηln2，再加比η更小阶的项，这个比值趋于ln2。

sentences.en: Its numerical value is about zero point six nine three one four seven.
In decibels relative to N zero, this is about negative one point five nine one seven four five decibels.
sentences.zh: 以N₀为基准的分贝值约为−1.591745分贝。

sentences.en: This is a limiting minimum, approached at vanishing spectral efficiency.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极限最小值，在频谱效率趋零时逼近。

sentences.en: At every finite positive eta, the ratio is strictly larger than natural log two.
sentences.zh: 对每个有限正η，该比值都严格大于ln2。

sentences.en: Finite constellations and practical codes may require still more energy.
sentences.zh: 有限星座和实际编码可能需要更多能量。

sentences.en: The frontier assumes capacity-achieving signaling and coding.
sentences.zh: 该前沿假设采用达到容量的调制与编码。

sentences.en: For comparison with the lecture plot, place energy per bit over noise density on the horizontal axis.
sentences.zh: 为与讲义图对照，将归一化每比特能量置于横轴。

sentences.en: Place spectral efficiency in bits per second per hertz on the vertical axis.
sentences.zh: 将每赫兹每秒比特数表示的频谱效率置于纵轴。

sentences.en: Moving toward higher spectral efficiency raises the energy requirement.
sentences.zh: 向更高频谱效率移动会提高能量需求。

sentences.en: At fixed positive rate, approaching the minimum energy requires ever more bandwidth.
sentences.zh: 在固定正速率下，逼近最低能量需要越来越大的带宽。

sentences.en: The two resources trade against each other.
sentences.zh: 这两种资源彼此权衡。

sentences.en: The curve is obtained from a formula, not an experimental measurement.
sentences.zh: 该曲线由公式计算，而非实验测量。

sentences.en: Keep actual rate R distinct from capacity C in the energy definition.
sentences.zh: 能量定义中要区分实际速率R与容量C。

sentences.en: Only on the frontier may they be set equal.
sentences.zh: 只有在前沿上才能令二者相等。

sentences.en: The next comparison asks what practical signaling curves can be inferred.
sentences.zh: 下一章将讨论可以从实际调制曲线推断什么。

sentences.en: A modulation family restricts which waveforms represent transmitted symbols.
sentences.zh: 调制族限制哪些波形可表示发送符号。

sentences.en: Different families use amplitude, phase, timing, or orthogonal waveforms differently.
sentences.zh: 不同调制族对振幅、相位、时序或正交波形的使用不同。

sentences.en: The lecture compares several named families at a displayed error target.
sentences.zh: 讲义在图示错误目标下比较若干调制族。

sentences.en: The displayed target is P capital M equal to ten to negative five.
sentences.zh: 图中目标为P_M=10^−5。

sentences.en: The source lists QAM with sixteen and sixty-four signal points.
sentences.zh: 原图列出16阶与64阶QAM。

sentences.en: Quadrature amplitude modulation varies both in-phase and quadrature amplitudes.
sentences.zh: 正交振幅调制同时改变同相与正交分量的振幅。

sentences.en: Its symbols are naturally represented using two real coordinates.
sentences.zh: 其符号自然用两个实坐标表示。

sentences.en: Sixteen-QAM and sixty-four-QAM have different point densities and decision regions.
sentences.zh: 16-QAM与64-QAM具有不同点密度和判决区域。

sentences.en: The source also lists four- and eight-level PAM in a single-sideband context.
sentences.zh: 原图还列出单边带语境下的4阶与8阶PAM。

sentences.en: Pulse-amplitude modulation primarily varies one real amplitude coordinate.
sentences.zh: 脉冲振幅调制主要改变一个实振幅坐标。

sentences.en: Single-sideband signaling changes how the spectrum occupies the channel.
sentences.zh: 单边带传输会改变频谱占用方式。

sentences.en: Phase-shift keying uses distinct carrier phases.
sentences.zh: 相移键控使用不同载波相位。

sentences.en: The listed orders are four, eight, and sixteen.
sentences.zh: 列出的阶数为4、8与16。

sentences.en: Ideal phase-constellation points share a common radius; pulse shaping also affects the transmitted envelope.
sentences.zh: 理想相位星座点具有相同半径；脉冲成形也影响发送包络。

sentences.en: Differential phase-shift keying encodes changes between successive phases.
sentences.zh: 差分相移键控编码相邻时刻的相位变化。

sentences.en: It can avoid requiring an absolute carrier phase reference.
sentences.zh: 它可以避免要求绝对载波相位参考。

sentences.en: The listed differential orders are two, four, and eight.
sentences.zh: 列出的差分阶数为2、4与8。

sentences.en: Orthogonal signaling assigns different symbols to mutually orthogonal waveforms.
sentences.zh: 正交信号传输将不同符号分配给两两正交波形。

sentences.en: The source lists orders eight, sixteen, thirty-two, and sixty-four.
Its caption specifies coherent detection.
sentences.zh: 图注注明采用相干检测。

sentences.en: Coherent detection uses a phase reference to compare received waveform components.
sentences.zh: 相干检测使用相位参考来比较接收波形分量。

sentences.en: Larger orthogonal families trade more signal dimensions for symbol choices.
sentences.zh: 更大的正交族以更多信号维度换取更多符号选择。

sentences.en: These families occupy real or complex dimensions in different ways.
sentences.zh: 这些调制族以不同方式占用实维或复维。

sentences.en: Their bandwidth efficiency depends on pulse shapes and symbol rates.
sentences.zh: 它们的带宽效率取决于脉冲形状与符号率。

sentences.en: Energy efficiency depends on coding, detection, and error definitions. Can the plot determine universal numerical curves?
sentences.zh: 能量效率依赖编码、检测与错误定义。仅凭这张图能确定通用的数值曲线吗？

sentences.en: The source does not specify every pulse-shape or coding assumption.
sentences.zh: 原图没有说明所有脉冲形状或编码假设。

sentences.en: It also does not fully define coherent, hard, or soft processing for every curve.
sentences.zh: 它也未为每条曲线完整定义相干、硬判决或软处理。

sentences.en: Therefore its plot supports a qualitative scheme comparison only.
sentences.zh: 因此该图只支持调制方案的定性比较。

sentences.en: It does not establish Shannon capacity achievability for those schemes.
sentences.zh: 它不能证明这些方案达到Shannon容量。

sentences.en: Exact reconstruction requires occupied bandwidth, symbol rate, code rate, and detector assumptions.
sentences.zh: 精确重建需要占用带宽、符号率、码率与检测器假设。

sentences.en: The exact numerical curves depend on these assumptions, while the Shannon frontier remains a separate benchmark.
sentences.zh: 精确数值曲线依赖这些假设，Shannon前沿则是独立基准。

sentences.en: Return to capacity: W times log base two of one plus the ratio P divided by the product N zero times W.
sentences.zh: 回到容量公式C=Wlog₂(1+P/(N₀W))。

sentences.en: First hold bandwidth W fixed and increase total power P.
sentences.zh: 先固定带宽W并增大总功率P。

sentences.en: Capacity rises logarithmically with that increase.
sentences.zh: 容量随功率增加而按对数上升。

sentences.en: Doubling power does not generally double capacity.
sentences.zh: 功率加倍通常不会令容量加倍。

sentences.en: Now hold power P fixed and increase bandwidth W.
sentences.zh: 现在固定功率P并增大带宽W。

sentences.en: Capacity rises but approaches the finite wideband limit.
sentences.zh: 容量会上升，但趋于有限的宽带极限。

sentences.en: At the same time, spectral efficiency tends toward zero.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，频谱效率趋于零。

sentences.en: The coefficients become weaker while their number per second grows.
sentences.zh: 每个系数变弱，但每秒系数数量增加。

sentences.en: Power and bandwidth therefore provide different routes to higher rate.
sentences.zh: 因此功率与带宽是提高速率的不同途径。

sentences.en: Neither resource is free in a physical communication system.
sentences.zh: 在实际通信系统中，这两种资源都不是免费的。

sentences.en: Increasing one resource can reduce pressure on the other.
sentences.zh: 增加一种资源可以减轻对另一种资源的压力。

sentences.en: The Shannon frontier quantifies the energy cost of spectral efficiency.
sentences.zh: Shannon前沿量化了频谱效率对应的能量代价。

sentences.en: Its lowest limiting energy requires spectral efficiency to approach zero.
sentences.zh: 最低极限能量要求频谱效率趋于零。

sentences.en: At positive spectral efficiency, the required energy is strictly above that limit.
sentences.zh: 频谱效率为正时，所需能量严格高于该极限。

sentences.en: The formula assumes ideal real lowpass AWGN conditions.
sentences.zh: 该公式假设理想实低通AWGN条件。

sentences.en: Practical signaling may require more energy at the same spectral efficiency than the Gaussian-input frontier.
sentences.zh: 在相同频谱效率下，实际调制可能比高斯输入前沿需要更多能量。

sentences.en: The gap reflects input restrictions and implementation assumptions.
sentences.zh: 差距反映输入限制与实现假设。

sentences.en: A modulation curve must be read together with its detection rules.
sentences.zh: 解读调制曲线时必须同时查看其检测规则。

sentences.en: It must also be read with its bandwidth and error target.
sentences.zh: 还必须结合带宽与错误目标解读。

sentences.en: The source comparison displays the common error target P capital M equal to ten to negative five.
sentences.zh: 原图比较显示共同错误目标P_M=10^−5。

sentences.en: It does not provide enough data to recover every precise curve point.
sentences.zh: 它没有提供足够数据来恢复每个精确曲线点。

sentences.en: The capacity equations remain the precise benchmark in this episode.
sentences.zh: 本集中容量方程仍是精确基准。

sentences.en: The time-bandwidth count explains the conversion from uses to seconds.
sentences.zh: 时间带宽自由度计数解释了从使用次数到秒的换算。

sentences.en: The noise integral explains the term N zero W.
sentences.zh: 噪声积分解释了N₀W这一项。

sentences.en: The wideband limit explains why rate saturates at fixed power.
sentences.zh: 宽带极限解释了固定功率下速率为何饱和。

sentences.en: The energy relation explains the price of a chosen spectral efficiency.
sentences.zh: 能量关系解释了指定频谱效率的代价。

sentences.en: These pieces describe one consistent real-channel model.
sentences.zh: 这些部分共同描述一个一致的实信道模型。

sentences.en: That allocation will use the same total-power principle.
sentences.zh: 该分配仍将使用相同的总功率原则。

sentences.en: The resource tradeoff now has a precise rate and energy scale.
sentences.zh: 现在资源权衡已有精确的速率与能量尺度。

sentences.en: The next episode allocates power across parallel frequency channels.
sentences.zh: 下一集将在并行频率信道之间分配功率。
